description: Upload a picture or any other file (a path in `file`, or a picture's bytes in `data` when you have the image and no file) and get back the markdown line that points at it. Files up to 10MB, pictures up to 5MB. WHERE THE LINE GOES DEPENDS ON WHAT THE FILE IS EVIDENCE OF. Proof that work you are handing in holds (a screen that renders right, a total that matches) goes in that check's `ran` on hand_in, and nothing new is written: a check answered with a picture is shown, which is what the hand-in asks for. A picture that is part of the work itself (the screenshot of a bug, a diagram it explains) goes in its text (create_work, or update_work), because work travels as its text and a file beside it does not travel at all. DO NOT WRITE NEW WORK TO CARRY SCREENSHOTS: six images and a caption each is a hand-in. With `project`, the file is kept in that project instead. Pictures (png, jpg, webp, gif) are drawn where they are named; anything else is a file to download.

data.description: a picture itself, base64 (a data: URL is fine), for when a tool handed you the image and never wrote it to disk

file.description: path to the file on this machine

name.description: label for it; defaults to its filename

project.description: keep it in this project instead

type.description: media type of `data`: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp or image/gif

name: add_file
title: Add a file
